analogy.name: A coat check
analogy.line: The ticket number (hash) tells the attendant which hook to go to. If two coats share a hook, they check the name tag (equals) to hand you yours.

analogy.name: Desk, filing cabinet, archive
analogy.line: New papers land on the desk (Eden) and most are binned quickly. What survives a few clear-outs gets filed (survivor), then archived (old generation), which is cleaned rarely and slowly.
